reports.desc: Offered a home job assembling product but ended up doing tasks till my shipment arrived. At first it seemed legit. But then tgey would add on another task to do and if you didnt complete it you lost your money. Never was told ahead of time about a second task. Just out of the blue popped that on you to press you for more money involved. Never got my money back. Never got my bonuses ether.
PayPal is covering for this furdulent company.

I added money to this website and then made a Redemption on 9/12/26 for $100. It States on their website that they usually pay out within 48 hours but up to 72 hours. That was a week ago and I still have never received any payment. I have contacted customer service several different times with zero to little communication or response and no resolution

Depop sells items through vendors. The vendor for this sale took my money then sent a different item. Imagine ordering and paying $60 for a pizza and someone delivers a jar of peanuts. Depop has no customer support or direct contact information which is indicative of it being a scam.

I was on Facebook but I went to Walmart app from there. The possible scam was answer 4 questions correctly to win an Ecoflow electrical generator & pay $9 s/h. I thought it suspicious but I have Walmarts app, so I gave it a try. Entered my card info but the bank thought it was suspicious, denied the transaction & suggested I cancel the card of which I did & to report it to Walmart of which I did.
Said I won from Publishing Clearing House

Found the job posting on Indeed. It seemed legitimate at first and had contact with the company in phone calls and emails and through there online portal. Inspecting packages and re-shipping them. Until the police showed up and confiscated a package saying it was bought with a stolen credit card. I contacted the company immediately to inform them and surrendered the package to the police department. After that i tried to reach back out to the company regarding the other packages i had to ship out and how to proceed but cannot get in contact with them or log into my portal through them. They had me do an interview and fill out tax documents as well.

I filled out return of goods form and send within 90 days.  I sent packages back on 9/3/2026 by USPS with signature required. And tracker stated packages were received on 9/8/2026. I contacted Harold Customer Support by email with tracking number. 9/10/2026 Harold said he received tracking number and was going to search f I r thw packages. No response as of 9/18/2026.No updates and no refund for Package #******

I signed up for a low cost trial for $10 and then paid for additional services for $29 to help with my resume. However, I canceled the subscription service and never thought anything of it. I recently noticed a $75 charge on my account on Sept. 15, 2026 and contacted them because this should have been canceled months ago.
I reviewed my account and they had been charging me $75/month since March.
I requested a refund for $300 of the $375 but they kept saying they would only provide a 50% refund for the Sept charge which is ridiculous. I even offered $300 in case I canceled after the trial period, but I definitely canceled months ago because the service was no good!
As another person stated, it is just an automated AI response which is attached, regardless of my request for a proper refund. Nothing but a scam.

I have been getting spam calls from them. I am handling that with the FTC. This loan business is claiming they are listed on BBB, though they are not. Figured you should know: https://prosperfundinggroup.com/
Purchased a denim bag and was scammed never received it... person uses afterpay due to afterpay not pursuing scam sellers on their platform ..you are left arguing with your bank!

They call me from different numbers about ten times a day, with the same name, Alvin Douglas. They avoid my spam blocker and every time I manually block, or call and opt out, about 15 more calls come from different numbers regarding a pre-approved loan with low interest rates.

On June 5, 2026 I purchased a set of Round Neck built in Bra Ribbed tank tops, an 8 piece pack from Tidewises.
Empowerhubup  store+96876790127@t.shopifyemail.com. Order number 1185 Tracking numberZ C0559551040.  I paid online via my PayPal account.   I was informed that the package was on its way.   A tracking package was provided, which overtime stated it was on its way.    Fast forward September 16, and I have yet to receive this order.  I made contacts along the way to check, and I was told that it is on the way, and should be delivered by August 16th.  I never received this.  I sent an email letting them know that I will be reporting this to BBB.  I requested a refund several times, and kept getting "it is on its way, please be patient".  three months is too long for one delivery.  Thank you.

I attempted to contact them after the purchase since I expected a receipt, no call no response to email, could not locate business address nor warehouses indicated, reported to Credit card and filed a fraud report. next day web site was removed by lovable.dev/abuse.  I did a further search on the telephone # and a similar scam by a company selling high end lawn service equipment, called same # no answer
